changes.summary: We are delighted to announce that we have appointed Lina Ghotmeh — Architecture (LG—A), led by the multi award-winning Lina Ghotmeh, to redesign our Western Range galleries. These galleries represent over a third of our display space, and house the Rosetta Stone, the Parthenon Sculptures and the Assyrian lion hunt. From over 60 entrants, the Museum invited five internationally-acclaimed teams to take part in a two-stage architectural competition. LG—A's bold vision for the galleries was then displayed in the newly reopened Reading Room. The French-Lebanese architect Ghotmeh likens each new project to an archaeological dig, looking at a building's past to support the reimagination and 'story' of its future, with sustainability at its heart and a close observance to the use of natural materials. The Museum is excited to work with the LG—A-led team to rethink the Museum's building, which will be an ambitious transformation of the gallery spaces, public areas and back-of-house facilities.
